name: pa-w8
prompt:
Append a new block at the very END of web/src/styles.css (add nothing anywhere else) with the styles for archiving projects in the sidebar. Use only the existing custom properties (var(--muted), var(--line), var(--radius), var(--surface-2), var(--accent-strong)). Rules, with these exact selectors:
- a comment `/* PROJ-ARCHIVE: the options menu on each project, the archived group and its toggle */`
- `.project-row`: position relative, display flex, align-items center, gap 0.15rem, border-radius 6px (the menu is placed under it).
- `.project-row > .project-head`: flex 1, min-width 0.
- `.project-more`: flex none, width 2rem, height 2rem, color var(--muted). Always visible (no hover-only opacity).
- inside `@media (max-width: 760px), (hover: none)`: `.project-more` width and height 2.75rem (44 px touch target).
- `.project.archived .project-name`: color var(--muted), font-weight 500.
- `.project:not(.archived) + .project.archived`: margin-top 0.35rem, padding-top 0.5rem, border-top 1px solid var(--line) (separates the archived group).
- `.archived-chip`: font-size 0.7rem, flex none.
- `.archived-toggle`: align-items center, color var(--muted), font-size 0.85rem.
- `.archived-toggle[aria-pressed="true"]`: color var(--accent-strong).
- `.archived-bar`: display flex, align-items center, gap 0.5rem, margin-bottom 0.75rem, padding 0.5rem 0.75rem, border 1px solid var(--line), border-radius var(--radius), background var(--surface-2), font-size 0.88rem.
- `.archived-bar > span`: flex 1.
- inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`: `.project.archived, .archived-bar` get `animation: kk-archive-in 0.18s ease-out;`
- `@keyframes kk-archive-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-2px); } }`
To append, use one SEARCH block holding the last lines of the file and a REPLACE block with those same lines followed by the new block.
